# Pendo and the Roar That Saved the Pride

Once upon a time, in the heart of the golden Serengeti, a tiny lion cub named Pendo lived with his pride. Pendo loved his mother, Mara, more than anyone else. She was warm, gentle, and always brought back the best food after a hunt. But Pendo was terrified of his father, the great King Kojo. Kojo had a massive black mane, a scar over his left eye, and a roar that made the entire earth shake. Whenever Kojo walked by, Pendo would hide behind his mother's paws. "Why is Baba so scary?" Pendo whimpered one afternoon. "He never plays with me. He just growls and sleeps."

Mara nudged her cub gently, her golden eyes filled with warmth. "Your father has a different job than I do, little one. You will understand one day."

The very next evening, a thick fog rolled across the grasslands. Mara and the other lionesses had gone out to hunt, leaving the cubs resting near the edge of the rocky kopje. Pendo was practicing his pouncing on a blade of grass when the wind shifted. Suddenly, a terrifying sound echoed through the brush. Laughing. A cackle of spotted hyenas emerged from the shadows, their eyes locked onto the unprotected cubs. Pendo's heart hammered against his ribs. He tried to let out a warning roar, but it came out as a tiny, helpless squeak. The hyenas drew closer, baring their sharp teeth. Before the lead hyena could take another step, a sound shattered the night. It wasn't a roar; it was an earthquake. King Kojo burst through the fog like a shooting star. He didn't look lazy or distant anymore. His eyes blazed with fire. With one massive swipe of his heavy paw, he sent the lead hyena flying into the bushes. He stood tall over Pendo and the other cubs, his giant mane puffed out, unleashing a roar so powerful it rattled Pendo's teeth. Terrified by the sheer force of the king, the remaining hyenas scattered into the darkness, never looking back. Kojo stood breathing heavily, guarding the perimeter until he was certain the danger had passed.

Then, the giant king turned around. Pendo shrank back, expecting a scolding for being so close to the edge. Instead, Kojo lowered his massive head all the way to the dirt. He gently nudged Pendo with his giant, scarred nose, checking him for scratches. For the first time, Pendo realized his father's rough exterior wasn't because he was mean—it was the armor he wore to keep the pride safe. When Mara returned, she found Pendo curled up tightly against his father's massive, warm belly, fast asleep under the stars.
